The prepared manifest's dof_publication/dof_last_reform/note fields are provenance context, not part of the operational batch-manifest schema, and are dropped here rather than smuggled in as unknown properties.
A live recheck of all eight source_pdf URLs on 2026-08-06 returned HTTP 206 for each.
Instrument order is preserved from the prepared cluster-2 plan, including lfgfaga before its regulation.
